protocol.patch: original receiver MLP output + strength * (full donor MOLT contribution - full receiver MOLT contribution)
protocol.gate_only: original receiver MLP output + strength * (donor gate - receiver gate) * receiver low-rank output
protocol.ablation: original receiver MLP output - strength * receiver MOLT contribution
protocol.interpretation: Shared arthropod/animal labels are hypotheses, not dedicated spider or ant representations. All direct edits are confined to one layer and one position per trial.
